core_obligations: (1) The colimit in j_pG(V) runs over opens W of X with V subset W ordered by reverse inclusion; this system has the largest element V itself, so j_pG(V) = G(V) (proof lines 4694-4697). (2) V -> G(V) for V open in U is a sheaf on U whenever G is a sheaf on X (proof lines 4698-4700). (3) For u in U the open neighbourhoods of u contained in U are cofinal among all neighbourhoods of u in X, so the stalks computed from (2) identify with G_u (proof lines 4700-4702). (4), (5) For a (pre)sheaf F on U, j^{-1}j_*F(V) = j_*F(V) = F(V) by the computations above, so the counits are identities (proof lines 4703-4704). The same arguments run verbatim for abelian groups, algebraic structures and modules (proof lines 4706-4709).
proof_roadmap: Evaluate the colimit defining j_pG(V) via its largest element (proof lines 4694-4697).
Deduce (2)-(5) by restriction being a sheaf, cofinality of small neighbourhoods, and direct evaluation (proof lines 4698-4709).
